_readme: Example settings. Copy to config.json and adjust before the first run (ask the end user for their budget, excluded districts and schedule). Money unit: 만원 (10,000 KRW).
_comment_match: match: any unit type / deposit-ratio option with deposit <= max_deposit_manwon AND rent <= max_rent_manwon. near: not match, but deposit <= max + near_tolerance_deposit AND rent <= max + near_tolerance_rent.
_help_lease_types: Which lease types to track: ["monthly"] (월세, default), ["jeonse"] (전세) or both. Each selected type gets its own alert block.
_help_targets: Household types: ["youth"] (청년, default), ["newlywed"] (신혼부부·예비신혼부부·신생아) or both. Only selected targets are shown; unit rows for other targets are ignored.
_help_monthly: Monthly-rent limits below (top-level keys; may also be written as a "monthly": {...} block).
_help_jeonse: Used only when lease_types includes "jeonse". match: a jeonse unit (deposit only) or jeonse-like monthly option (rent <= jeonse_like_max_rent AND deposit >= jeonse_like_min_deposit, shown with 🔁) with deposit <= max_deposit. near: deposit <= max + near_tolerance.
_help_support_programs: true/false. Lists 전세임대 programs (tenant finds the house; notice-level, no price judgment) in a short 📋 section when new or closing soon. null = on if jeonse is selected.
_help_conversion_rate_pct: Optional 전월세 전환율 for display only; never used for matching.
_help_exclude_gu: Districts (자치구) to exclude from matching, e.g. ["OO구"]. Empty list = no exclusion.
_help_soco_assumed_window_days: If the 청년안심주택 list shows no closing date, assume the application window lasts this many days.
_help_docs: Attachment extraction for new/unpriced notices. Text PDFs (pdfplumber) and HWP (rhwp-python) tables are parsed automatically. ocr=false (default): image-only notices are rendered to page PNGs and left for the agent to read (status needs_agent). ocr=true enables experimental tesseract OCR (results marked unverified).
_help_pages: lh_rolling_days: also list LH notices posted within this many days that are still open (year-round rolling programs). Omit to use the default (0 for a monthly+youth-only config, i.e. original behaviour; 365 otherwise). hug: number of latest HUG 든든전세 notices to read.
